name: io.github.francescomalatesta/laravel-forge-mcp
title: Laravel Forge MCP
description: Unofficial MCP server for Laravel Forge: manage servers, sites and deployments.

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Laravel Forge API token (Account settings → API tokens).

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_ORGANIZATION
environmentVariables.description: Default organization slug used when a tool call omits it.

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated toolsets to enable ('default', 'all' or names like 'core,sites,databases').

environmentVariables.name: FORGE_ALLOW_SECRETS
environmentVariables.description: Register tools that return secrets (.env contents, credentials, keys).
